project_context.target_audience: Car enthusiasts, detailers looking for an extra skill, mechanics, DIYers

typography.strategy: Aggressive, technical, high-performance. Avoid Inter/Roboto. Use uppercase for major headings.

spacing_and_layout.grid_system: Bento Grid (Control Room style for data, Tetris style for features)

buttons.primary: bg-[#D71920] hover:bg-[#9E1118] text-white font-heading text-2xl uppercase tracking-wider px-8 py-4 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(215,25,32,0.4)] hover:shadow-[0_0_30px_rgba(215,25,32,0.6)] transition-all duration-300
buttons.sticky_mobile: fixed bottom-4 left-4 right-4 z-50 bg-[#D71920] text-white text-center font-heading text-xl py-3 rounded shadow-2xl border border-white/10 flex justify-center items-center gap-2
buttons.whatsapp_float: fixed bottom-20 md:bottom-6 right-4 md:right-6 z-50 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-xl hover:scale-110 transition-transform

cards.offer_card: bg-[#171A20] border-2 border-[#D71920] rounded-xl p-8 shadow-[0_0_40px_rgba(215,25,32,0.15)] relative overflow-hidden
cards.module_card: bg-gradient-to-br from-[#171A20] to-[#08090C] border border-white/5 hover:border-[#D71920]/50 p-6 rounded-lg transition-colors group

badges.guarantee: inline-flex items-center gap-2 bg-[#F4B000]/10 text-[#F4B000] px-4 py-1.5 rounded-full text-sm font-bold border border-[#F4B000]/20
badges.discount: bg-[#D71920] text-white px-3 py-1 rounded font-bold text-sm tracking-wide

micro_animations.hero_image: Subtle pulse or breathing effect on the glowing headlight image.
micro_animations.hover_states: Buttons scale up slightly (scale-105). Cards lift up (-translate-y-1) with glow effect.
micro_animations.scroll_reveal: Fade up and in (translate-y-4 to 0, opacity 0 to 1) using framer-motion as user scrolls.
micro_animations.sticky_cta: Slide up from bottom after 30% scroll depth (opacity 0 -> 1, y: 50 -> 0).

media_urls.description: Hero headlight glowing in the dark
Sports car headlight detail for aesthetic

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a high-converting Portuguese Brazilian Landing Page.
Install tailwindcss, lucide-react, framer-motion if needed. You are working with .js, NOT .tsx.

Do NOT use Inter or Roboto. Add Google Fonts 'Bebas Neue' and 'Manrope' to index.html or global css. Update tailwind.config.js to set `fontFamily: { heading: ['Bebas Neue', 'sans-serif'], sans: ['Manrope', 'sans-serif'] }`.
Create the specific blocks: HERO, PROBLEM, OPPORTUNITY, WHAT YOU'LL LEARN, MODULES, BONUSES, OFFER CARD, POTENTIAL, FOR WHOM / NOT FOR WHOM, GUARANTEE, FAQ, FINAL CTA.
Offer Card must vividly display the R$ 69,90 price point with a strong red border on a graphite background.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include `data-testid` (e.g., `data-testid="hero-cta"`).
Implement the sticky CTA for mobile. Hide it initially and reveal after 30% scroll using Framer Motion.
Ensure total dark mode aesthetic with deep blacks (#08090C), graphite (#171A20), and aggressive red (#D71920) accents. NO purple/violet gradients.
